article.headline: NFL Spotter and Broadcaster David Moulton Dies Following Six-Year Cancer Battle
article.summary: The longtime sports media figure and former NFL broadcast assistant died at age 59 while in hospice care.
article.body:
David Moulton spent six years fighting stage four renal cell cancer, a condition that eventually metastasized to his bones two years ago. His wife, Julie, confirmed he passed away in hospice care at the Douglas Center for Caring on the night of Friday, October 23, according to reports citing his death announcement on Saturday, October 24. Even while undergoing various medical treatments, Moulton maintained his professional commitments, including his role as an NFL spotter and his career in local media.

The impact of his loss is felt throughout the sports broadcasting community, where he was highly regarded for his work behind the scenes. Troy Aikman, who worked closely with Moulton in the broadcast booth starting in 2018, described him as a loyal and dependable colleague who became a cherished friend. Aikman noted that Moulton was a warrior until the very end, serving as his right-hand man while helping the broadcast team track players and analyze games for millions of viewers.

Moulton’s career spanned decades, beginning with his arrival in Fort Myers in the late nineties as a sports anchor. He served as the Sports Director at ABC7 and became a recognizable voice as a co-host of the "Miller and Moulton" radio show. Beyond his national work with the NFL, he was known as the voice of FGCU Athletics and a staple of sports media across the Gulf Coast. He first publicly shared his diagnosis in 2020 after the discovery of a large tumor led to the surgical removal of his left kidney, but despite persistent treatment efforts, the cancer progressed to stage four.

His family has expressed gratitude for the widespread support received throughout his long battle. Colleagues and listeners remember him as a friendly face who brought consistent dedication to his craft throughout his time in sports journalism.

article.body: استيقظ سكان المنطقة الشرقية ومحافظة الخرج فجر اليوم الثلاثاء على إنذارات طارئة عبر المنصة الوطنية للإنذار المبكر، محذرة من تهديد وشيك قبل أن تنجح أنظمة الدفاع الجوي في اعتراض وتدمير 3 صواريخ باليستية. هذا الهجوم الذي شنته الميليشيا الحوثية يمثل تصعيداً عسكرياً يتطلب استجابة سريعة من منظومات الدفاع المشتركة لضمان أمن المناطق المستهدفة وحماية المدنيين والمرافق الحيوية في تلك المناطق. وفقاً لما أعلنته قيادة القوات المشتركة لتحالف دعم الشرعية في اليمن، فإن العملية العسكرية النوعية تضمنت رصد الصواريخ فور إطلاقها والتعامل معها بنجاح في الجو قبل وصولها إلى أهدافها. وقد تلا عمليات الاعتراض الناجحة إعلان رسمي من الدفاع المدني يطمئن السكان بزوال الخطر عن المنطقتين اللتين شهدتا حالة من الاستنفار الأمني خلال الساعات الأولى من الصباح. وتأتي هذه التطورات في ظل جهود مستمرة من التحالف للتصدي للهجمات الباليستية التي تستهدف الأراضي السعودية بشكل متكرر. وبينما تم تدمير الصواريخ بنجاح، تظل أنظمة الرصد والمراقبة التابعة لقوات التحالف في حالة تأهب قصوى لرصد أي تهديدات محتملة أو عمليات عدائية أخرى قد تُنفذ في الفترة المقبلة. وتؤكد البيانات الرسمية أن الدفاع المدني استجاب فورياً للواقعة عبر تفعيل أنظمة الإنذار المبكر، مما ساهم في رفع جاهزية المواطنين والمقيمين في المناطق المشمولة بالتحذير، قبل إصدار بيان لاحق يؤكد انتهاء الموقف الأمني واستعادة الاستقرار في المواقع التي كانت مستهدفة.

Sport Ministry Issues Regulations Governing Ticket Sales for Sports Events
news.og_title: Sport Ministry Issues Regulations Governing Ticket Sales for Sports Events
news.og_desc:
Riyadh, October 26, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Sport issued regulations today governing ticket sales and resale for sports competitions and events in Saudi Arabia, aimed at protecting consumers' rights, curbing unauthorized practices, and strengthening compliance and oversight.
    The ministry will launch a ticketing platform accreditation service through its Riyadhi Platform on November 15. Existing ticketing platforms will have 90 days from the date the regulations were issued to comply with approved technical and regulatory requirements.
    The regulations restrict ticket sales and resale to event organizers and ministry-accredited platforms, which must ensure secure transactions, protect consumer data, handle high demand, and provide clear procedures for complaints, cancellations, and refunds.
    They also require transparency in ticket prices, fees, and refund policies, while prohibiting hidden fees, misleading pricing, unauthorized ticket trading, and the use of automated software or multiple accounts to bypass purchase limits.
    Additional provisions include linking tickets to buyers' identities, setting individual purchase limits, observing venue capacities, and meeting cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
    The regulations aim to strengthen governance in the sports sector, protect consumers' rights, and improve the spectator experience.
    -- SPA
